turns.text: In the beginning, it was very happy.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: This is a small apartment.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: In a few years, I'll move elsewhere.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Have some dinner before you go out.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Mom, I'm not hungry right now.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: After unpacking, I went downstairs for dinner.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: How is the food in the hotel's restaurant?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: From now on, we're going to exercise more.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Shall we go jogging together?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: When is the meeting scheduled for?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: They will tell us in advance of it.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: When was the last time you went traveling?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I went to Japan five years ago.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I heard your girlfriend had a lot of homework.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Once she finished, we went out.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The concert tonight is sold out.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: We bought our tickets ahead of time.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Has the meeting started?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Am I late?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: No.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: You're just on time.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: We got here at the same time.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Did you take the subway from Yaksu?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Is Veronica in?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: She is not in at the moment.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Are classes going to begin soon?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: They were canceled as of 9 a.m.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: What are you going to do next?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I don't have any plans for now.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: You don't look good these days.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I've been sick a lot.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: How are things going with you recently?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I've been doing the same old thing.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: A lot of work, as usual.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I put Bill in charge until I return.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Are you sure that's a good idea?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Will the stage be ready by Friday?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: They should be able to get it ready by then.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: How are you enjoying summer camp?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I've loved it up to now.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Does your son like going to university?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: So far, he thinks it is great.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Has Alicia come to see you?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: To date, she hasn't been here.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I hope you'll come back soon.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I'm only going out for a while.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Do you mind if I sit here for a second?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yeah, sure thing.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Can you move this piano out of here?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It has to stay for the time being.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: She's been in school for a long time.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: She must be a very good student.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: When was the company started?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It was founded over a hundred years ago.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Let's go to New York during summer vacation.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That would be a lot of fun.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Hey Joe, you sound tired.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I know.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I've been awake all night.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: How long have you been working on that project?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I have been working on it all day long.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I think mom and dad will be here soon.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: In the meantime, let's play a game.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Is this your first time to meet a movie star?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No, I've met famous people many times.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Is your girlfriend angry at you again?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, this has happened over and over again.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Do you brush your teeth often?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Sure, I brush them on a daily basis.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Are you still jogging every day?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, I run about 30 miles per week.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Every machine that I have has broken.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Maybe you should take better care of them.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Your dad is a very hard worker.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yeah, he's on the job day in and day out.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: It's time to start exercising.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Okay, everyone line up in a row.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Look, there is a big problem here.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: We'll have to do it all over again.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Your clock on the wall stopped working.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: From time to time the battery goes dead.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Do you go out to eat often?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Well, we go out to restaurants every now and then.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: We have to come here more often.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That's fine with me as long as you pay.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Once in a while I paint a picture.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Your paintings look really great.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Do you travel to other countries?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I've traveled overseas at times.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: When do you want this finished?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It must be done as quickly as possible.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: He always wants us to finish as soon as possible.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Your boss is a tough guy to work for.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: When are you going to take your driving test?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: As soon as I get used to driving in the rain.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Has the mailman come yet?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No, but he'll probably come anytime now.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I thought you were still working.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: We finished sooner than expected.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Your son has grown quite a lot.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: He's a junior in high school this year.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Are you going to be here on the weekend?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes, I will.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I have no plans yet.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I stayed out drinking beer last night.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That's not smart.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Your wife will be angry.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Have you had your wisdom teeth pulled out?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No, but I'm planning to have them extracted next month.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: When will your brother arrive?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: He's coming later this week.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'll start university.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I hope you enjoy studying there.

dialogues.expression: At the end of the day

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: When do you play World of Warcraft?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I usually start to play at the end of the day.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: When are you going to make a trip to Finland?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Someday.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I will make sure to visit Helsinki.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I don't care what happens in the future.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: How can you not care about your future?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: What happened when you were driving?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: All of a sudden.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I saw a policeman.

dialogues.expression: In the blink of an eye

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I hear that Paul has no money now.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: He lost it all in the blink of an eye.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Can we have a party tonight?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It will be difficult on such short notice.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Did you know she was coming to town?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: She arrived here out of the blue.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The letter from my boyfriend came at last.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Why did it take so long to arrive?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I heard you succeeded in getting a job.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Everything was fine in the long run.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: So you aren't trying to date Renee anymore?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No. In the end, I just gave up.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Barney and his girlfriend always argue.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: They should just break up once and for all.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I never learned how to drive.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Sooner or later you'll need to buy a car.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: You need to make money above all else.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: But I want to find a job I enjoy too.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Your brother was very rude at the party.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: To top it all off.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: He got drunk.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: People say you like to go jogging.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: In addition to jogging, I also do aerobics.

dialogues.expression: Not only A but also B

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Which one of these phones do you want to buy?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I'll take not only the silver one, but also the black one.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: This is by far my favorite TV show.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Me too.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I love the main actor.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I can't believe you went jogging this morning.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: In spite of being tired, I decided to exercise.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Do you want to get something to eat?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I'm still hungry even though I had dinner.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Daryl is a very cruel man.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Even so, we can't change his character.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: We can go camping this summer.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: On the other hand, we can stay in a hotel.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Let's leave work early today.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: But then we might lose our jobs.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I didn't know your wife likes sewing.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It's one of her hobbies.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: So to speak.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: How was your first day at work?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: In short.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Everything went wrong.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: So we must move to another department?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: That's in a nutshell.

dialogues.expression: To make a long story short

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Did you have a fight with Marsha?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: To make a long story short, yes.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: My boss said he would promote me.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: In other words, you'll be making more money?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Someone called from your school.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Oh.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I should give them a call back.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Have you ever been to Disneyland?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No. As a matter of fact, I haven't.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Do you want to go to the concert?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: As I told you before, I have no time for that.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'm sure we met somewhere before.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Now that you mention it, you look familiar.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Do you know what I mean?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Actually, I have no idea what you are talking about.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Have you attended a soccer match before?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I've been to quite a few soccer matches.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: These boxes have a lot of paperwork in them.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: We'd better put them in the closet.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: There are a number of students outside.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I think they're going to play some music.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I think it's going to rain today.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: At least the temperature is warm.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Can I have a bit of your chocolate bar?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Sure.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Here's a piece for you.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: There are a few things I need to do.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Well, let's meet up again later.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: These shoes are killing my feet.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It will take a couple of days to break them in.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Would you like to join me for dinner?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Well, I am kind of busy right now.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: How about tomorrow?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Can I have a piece of your pie?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It's right here.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Help yourself.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Do you have much work to do?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'm more or less finished.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Our business hasn't done well this year.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Step by step, your business will get bigger.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: How is your relationship with Hal?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: To a certain degree, it's pretty good.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: This TV weighs as much as an elephant.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Come on.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: It doesn't weigh that much.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Did you break up with your boyfriend?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: As far as me dating him, it's finished.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Dan and his friends are playing video games.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: They are so stupid.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: They just sit in front of computers.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Is it next to the stadium?.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: No.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: It is across the street.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Next to the post office.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Are Korean pop stars popular outside of Korea?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Especially in China.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: The woman sitting over there is my teacher.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: You mean the one with brown hair?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Where can I find the library?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It's the largest building in the neighborhood.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'm afraid to walk home alone.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I'll walk with you if you like.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Tony said that he'd pick up the tab.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: In that case, I'll have dessert.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: It looks as though the country is on its way to recovery.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I sure hope so.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: It's been a long and hard year.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: What if I said we had to work tomorrow?

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I'd pretend that I didn't hear you.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Let's say the electricity stopped working.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: That would mean many people would have problems.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: When it comes to computer problems, I would ask Tina.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: Do you know where she is right now?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I really like to go on long trips.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: As for me, I like to stay at home.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: I'd like to talk with you concerning tomorrow's meeting.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: What time would be good for you?

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: With regard to a job, I am trying to find one.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: It's very difficult to get hired these days.

turns.speaker: A
turns.text: Regarding your flight, it will be delayed.

turns.speaker: B
turns.text: I guess I will have to wait here.
